reasons: UNSUPPORTED: "In a 2007 interview Rodriguez recognized her potential in Sin City and Planet Terror; he makes actors feel anything is possible" (Interview says Rodriguez 'has identified this potential in me' and lets her try things; it does not name Sin City/Planet Terror in this context, and 'makes actors feel that anything is possible' is not in the fetched text. Attribute only what is quoted, or drop the wording.)

UNSUPPORTED: "Planet Terror shot first, Death Proof second, with largely the same crew, all at Troublemaker Studios in Austin" (Shooting order and Troublemaker Studios in Austin are confirmed. 'largely the same crew on both films' does not appear in the fetched text. Drop that clause.)

UNSUPPORTED: "She told the site the new film shows how characters changed about ten years after Scream 4" (The article says audiences will see how characters changed 'especially after 10 years'. That is the article's framing, not a quote from Shelton. Reattribute to the article or drop 'She told the site'.)

Reviewer recommends rejection: Rejected. Fix three unsupported statements: (1) drop 'with largely the same crew on both films' (Grindhouse interview); (2) drop or reattribute 'She told the site the new film shows... about ten years after Scream 4' (that is the E! article's framing, not Shelton's quote); (3) remove 'makes actors feel that anything is possible' and tie the Sin City/Planet Terror claim to what the interview says. The Sandlot Forever 2019 and NBC claims are now confirmed.
